intent: Stack consecutive messages from the same sender into one column.
typical_uses: A run of consecutive messages from one sender, shown as one block

dont_use_when.situation: Consecutive bubbles with no avatar, header or footer of their own
The scrolling frame around a whole transcript

invariants.text: The group is a flex column that spaces its children var(--space-2) apart and adds nothing else: no role, no alignment of its own and no avatar handling; each Message keeps its own `align`.

anti_patterns.dont: Leave the avatar slot out of the earlier messages of a group
anti_patterns.do_instead: Render an empty MessageAvatar on every message but the one that shows the avatar, so the surfaces of all messages in the group line up

good.title: Two messages from one sender, the avatar on the last one
good.code:
<MessageGroup>
  <Message>
    <MessageAvatar />
    <MessageContent>
      <Bubble>
        <BubbleContent>I checked the build output.</BubbleContent>
      </Bubble>
    </MessageContent>
  </Message>
  <Message>
    <MessageAvatar>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarFallback>AS</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
    </MessageAvatar>
    <MessageContent>
      <Bubble>
        <BubbleContent>The stale route is gone.</BubbleContent>
      </Bubble>
    </MessageContent>
  </Message>
</MessageGroup>

bad.title: The avatar slot left out of the earlier message
bad.code:
<MessageGroup>
  <Message>
    <MessageContent>
      <Bubble>
        <BubbleContent>I checked the build output.</BubbleContent>
      </Bubble>
    </MessageContent>
  </Message>
  <Message>
    <MessageAvatar>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarFallback>AS</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
    </MessageAvatar>
    <MessageContent>
      <Bubble>
        <BubbleContent>The stale route is gone.</BubbleContent>
      </Bubble>
    </MessageContent>
  </Message>
</MessageGroup>
bad.why: Without its avatar slot the first message's bubble starts at the row's edge while the second one's starts after the avatar, so the two surfaces of one sender do not line up.
